roles.title: Customer & Business Insights Analyst
roles.description: Customer and business insights in a consumer goods environment, covering churn, segmentation, experimentation, journey analysis and executive reporting.
highlights: Built predictive churn models with SQL, Python, Pandas and Scikit-learn to identify at-risk customer segments, reducing quarterly customer churn by 18%.
Segmented customers with RFM analysis in Snowflake and Tableau, supporting personalized lifecycle marketing that increased Customer Lifetime Value by 22%.
Designed controlled A/B testing frameworks with Python, SciPy and Mixpanel, translating results into recommendations that improved conversion rates by 14%.
Developed automated Power BI and Tableau dashboards covering sales, marketing attribution and customer satisfaction, cutting weekly manual reporting by 40%.
Analyzed checkout journeys in SQL and GA4, lifting conversion from 2.4% to 3.8%; market basket analysis across 500,000+ transactions increased Average Order Value by 15%.

roles.title: Business Insights Analyst
roles.description: Enterprise business intelligence: data pipelines, reporting workflows and sales dashboards for global sales teams.
highlights: Engineered enterprise data pipelines and automated reporting workflows supporting 15+ executive dashboards for 6,000+ global sales users.
Developed a centralized Points Analysis Dashboard that tracked $4.9M+ in sales compensation for 2,000+ sales executives across AMER, EMEA and APAC.
Integrated disparate reporting metrics into unified Smart Home Page dashboard cards in collaboration with engineering teams.
Reduced recurring monthly defects by 27% by investigating workflow defects in Buganizer with root cause analysis.
Validated legacy Taskmaster dashboards against the Smart Home Page platform, maintaining feature parity and preventing data discrepancies during the transition.
